## Teaching resources

::: indent-block
### [BIOL 300 Practice Hub](https://vbaliga.github.io/BIOL300-practicehub/)

Practice problems, worked solutions, and interactive tools for students in BIOL
300. Includes R coding exercises, test-selection flowchart, interactive formula
sheet, and guidance on statistical pitfalls.

### [statsapps](https://vbaliga.github.io/statsapps/)

An R package with interactive Shiny apps, designed to build intuition for
statistical concepts. Install from
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=statsapps) via:
`install.packages("statsapps")`

### [Multi-panel plots with R](https://flightlab.github.io/MultiPanelPlotsWithR)

Planning and constructing multi-panel, publication-quality figures using R. Uses
`ggplot2` to construct individual plots and `cowplot` to arrange them. Developed
for BIOL 548L (Visual and Oral Presentations), a graduate course at UBC.
:::
